reader_path.behavior: Copies watchdog configuration fields into the output block only when the corresponding globals are non-zero.

validator_path.behavior: Backfills missing watchdog configuration fields from the live globals and validates ordering/range constraints before returning success.

updater_path.behavior: Delegates directly to KiApplyProcessorDpcLimits; it is not the seeding caller for the profile globals.

interpretation.current_state: The current build has both a reader and a validator path for the DPC watchdog profile cluster, and both treat the live globals as default/fallback configuration state.
interpretation.remaining_gap: A registry seeding or initializer path for the globals is still missing; KiUpdateProcessorDpcWatchdogConfiguration only delegates to KiApplyProcessorDpcLimits.
interpretation.strength: This upgrades the cluster from docs-plus-live-state conflict to a real reader-and-validator-backed current-build lane.
